Execute an External Verification or Audit Script Inside the Isolated Sandbox

Source: R/handoff.R
verify_with_script.Rd

Runs an arbitrary external or project-local R audit/verification script (for example, a custom statistical consistency check, a statci CI audit, or a peer-reviewer validation script) inside rcapsule's clean, path-confined, ambient-secret-scrubbed sandbox via callr::rscript(). Captures exit status, duration, stdout/stderr, scrubbed environment variable names, SHA-256 hashes of every created or modified artifact, and optional checks on expected output files.

Usage

verify_with_script(
  script,
  path = ".",
  manifest = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  rng_kind = RNGkind(),
  env_vars = list(),
  timeout = 300,
  scrub_secrets = TRUE,
  keep_sandbox = FALSE,
  expected_outputs = NULL,
  args = character()
)

Arguments

script

Path to an existing .R script to execute inside the sandbox (may reside outside path, e.g. a shared organizational audit script).

path

Path to the project root directory to stage cleanly into the sandbox. Defaults to ".".

manifest

Optional rcapsule_manifest object or path to capsule.json used to exclude previously generated outputs when staging the sandbox.

seed

Optional integer RNG seed applied before sourcing script.

rng_kind

Character vector of length 3 from base::RNGkind(). Defaults to the current session's RNGkind().

env_vars

Optional named list of explicit environment variables passed to the sandboxed script.

timeout

Execution timeout in seconds (default 300).

scrub_secrets

Logical; if TRUE (default), strips ambient credential and token environment variables (AWS_*, GITHUB_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY, *_SECRET*, *_TOKEN*, etc.) before executing script.

keep_sandbox

Logical; if TRUE, retains the temporary sandbox directory on disk and returns its path in sandbox_dir. Defaults to FALSE.

expected_outputs

Optional character vector of project-relative output paths expected to exist in the sandbox after script finishes.

args

Optional character vector of string arguments forwarded to script via the RCAPSULE_AUDIT_ARGS environment variable (JSON array).

Value

An S3 object of class rcapsule_script_audit containing passed, status ("passed" or "failed"), exit_status, duration_sec, script, script_sha256, project_path, verified_at, rng, scrubbed_env_vars, stdout, stderr, artifacts (tibble of created or modified files with path, change, sha256, bytes, format), expected_checks (tibble checking expected_outputs), and sandbox_dir.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile("rcapsule_script_audit_")
dir.create(tmp)
write.csv(data.frame(x = 1:5), file.path(tmp, "data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
audit_script <- tempfile("audit_", fileext = ".R")
writeLines(
  c("df <- read.csv('data.csv')",
    "stopifnot(nrow(df) == 5L)",
    "writeLines('audit_ok', 'audit_report.txt')"),
  audit_script
)
res <- verify_with_script(
  script = audit_script,
  path = tmp,
  seed = 42L,
  expected_outputs = "audit_report.txt"
)
res
#> 
#> ── rcapsule Isolated Script Audit: PASSED ──────────────────────────────────────
#> • Script: audit_19a979760bd0.R (SHA-256: e292fbf19c2c...)
#> • Exit status: 0 | Duration: 0.13s | Scrubbed env vars: 41
#> • Created/modified artifacts: 1
#> 
#> ── Expected Output Checks ──
#> 
#> ✔ audit_report.txt (9 bytes)
unlink(c(tmp, audit_script), recursive = TRUE)
